items.heading: Some People Get Sharper When
items.text: Some people get sharper when they are in conversation, persuasion, collaboration, and visible movement. Others do better with long stretches of quiet, deep concentration, and system work.

items.heading: Write Down Three Situations Where
items.text: Write down three situations where you felt mentally strong. Note what you were doing, whether people were involved, and what kind of task it was.

visuals.heading: Write Down Three Tasks That

items.heading: Write Down Three Tasks That
items.text: Write down three tasks that drain you fast. This matters more than people think. A role that pays well can still become a bad long-term bet if its daily work repeatedly drains you.

items.heading: Sort Your Answers Into Patterns
items.text: Sort your answers into patterns. Are they mostly people-facing, analytical, visual, operational, or experimental?

items.heading: Shortlist Only Three Directions
items.text: Shortlist only three directions. Do not jump from the test straight to one final answer. Narrow the field first.
